title: CBDT Notifies ITR-BN for Block Assessment Cases Under Income Tax Rules 2026
content:
# CBDT Notifies ITR-BN for Block Assessment Cases Under Income Tax Rules 2026

Ek important update hai! Government ne Block Assessment Cases ke liye ek naya Income Tax Return (ITR) form, ITR-BN, announce kiya hai.

Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) ne Income-tax (Third Amendment) Rules, 2026 ko notify kar diya hai. Is amendment ke through, Income Tax Rules, 2026 mein ek naya Appendix 4 add kiya gaya hai, jo search aur requisition actions se related block assessment cases ke liye ITR-BN prescribe karta hai.

*   **Notification Details:** This change has been brought in through **Notification No. 97/2026 [F. No. 370142/11/2026-TPL] / GSR 656(E) dated July 24, 2026**.
*   **Applicability:** Yeh rules April 1, 2026, se effective honge. Ye un searches par apply honge jo Income-tax Act, 2025 ke Section 247 ke under ya requisitions jo Section 248 ke under, April 1, 2026 ko ya uske baad initiate ki gayi hain.
*   **Purpose:** ITR-BN ka maksad block assessment proceedings mein income aur undisclosed assets ki reporting ko streamline karna aur standardize karna hai.
